summary.text: Beth Anne Rankin is the Republican candidate for Arkansas House of Representatives District 99 in the November 3, 2026 general election; no other candidate is listed for the seat.
A business owner, she was a Republican candidate for Arkansas's 4th Congressional District in 2012.

paragraphs.text: Beth Anne Rankin earned a B.A. in history and music from Ouachita Baptist University.
She previously worked as policy advisor of state and federal affairs for the office of Governor Mike Huckabee and has owned Beth Anne Productions, Incorporated since 1998.
Rankin ran in the 2012 Republican primary for the U.S. House in Arkansas's 4th District and lost to Tom Cotton on May 22, 2012.
